provider.localDescription: Ollama, Chrome AI or OpenAI-compatible models running on this machine.
provider.remoteDescription: Chat with an Agent on a remote service. QwenPaw is the first supported backend.

settingsSection.description: QwenPaw is the first Remote Agent backend. Configure its service origin and browser credential below.

firstRun.title: Choose how you want to chat
firstRun.description: You can switch providers at any time from the sidebar header.

unavailableImages: This channel does not yet transmit image attachments.
unavailableFiles: This channel does not yet upload files to the Agent.
unavailableScreenshot: This channel does not yet transmit webpage screenshots or OCR images.
unavailableLocalTools: Local browser model tools are not connected in Remote mode. Tools are managed by the QwenPaw Agent.
unavailableSpeech: Speech input is not connected in Remote mode.
agentBound: Start a new chat to select a different Agent
nativeWelcome: Chat with your QwenPaw Agent. Use the page icon beside the input to share the current page or selected text.
nativeLimitations: Agent tools run remotely. Local RAG, MCP, model prompts, edit/regenerate, branching, files and temporary chat are not enabled for this channel.
privacy: Use a restricted browser credential, not a Console administrator token. Credentials remain in extension-local storage and are excluded from backups. Saving partitions old caches.
unavailable: QwenPaw browser APIs must be deployed on the service. A normal QwenPaw or OpenAI endpoint is not a substitute.
channelPreview: Basic channel: one Agent per endpoint, complete replies only. Recovery after disconnect or restart and browser approval cards are unavailable. Handle approvals in the QwenPaw Console separately. Do not resend an uncertain request.
agentNameHint: Leave blank to use the name published by the Remote Agent channel; if none is available, "default" is shown.
notCancel: Stopping display or closing this sidebar does not cancel the remote task.
retention: Remote history and memory follow server policies. Local display caches are not part of ordinary exports; resolved caches expire after 30 days.
removeConfirm: Remove this local cache only? This does not delete server history or memory.
confirm: I have previewed and confirm sharing this snapshot
stale: Page or active tab changed. Refresh and preview before sharing.
freshness: Snapshots do not update automatically. Refresh after page changes; source query strings and fragments are removed.
truncate: Content exceeds the limit. Explicitly truncate to {{limit}} characters and preview?
question: Ask the selected Agent…
noAttachments: Images, pasted files and dropped attachments are not supported in remote mode.
confirmRequired: Read, preview and confirm the snapshot before sharing.
empty: Create a remote chat to begin. No Ollama or local model configuration is required.
cached: Cached / disconnected — reconcile to confirm the latest state
approvalNotice: Approval scopes follow native server policy. Exact-target approval is not necessarily one-time. Approval does not mean execution succeeded.
decisionUnknown: Decision outcome is unconfirmed. Do not submit a different decision.
expired: Expired or unavailable; reconcile in Console.
creating: Creating or recovering a conversation is never automatically retried.
